title: RefinedLux
description: RefinedLux enhances vanilla Minecraft with refined visuals, smooth animations, and a clean, modern feel.
body:
**RefinedLux** is a lightweight **vanilla+** client modpack focused on visuals, animations, and quality-of-life enhancements.

It delivers a smoother, more immersive, and more polished Minecraft experience — while staying fully faithful to vanilla gameplay.
